chapters.title: Bring Dial Bot in
chapters.description: Dial Bot joins the review quietly, then introduces itself in Mira's private chat.
points: Yacine invites Dial Bot from Host Controls.
The three-card meeting settles into Standby.
Mira opens her private greeting and first-use guidance.

chapters.title: A quick answer
chapters.description: A spoken question gets a brief spoken date answer while the meeting continues.
points: The deck needs Friday's actual date.
Yacine asks Dial Bot aloud.
Mira returns to the slide with the answer.

chapters.title: Knowing its limits
chapters.description: Dial Bot waits until addressed and says when live weather data is unavailable.
points: An ordinary comment does not wake the Bot.
Yacine asks for current weather.
The Bot states its limit aloud.

chapters.title: A natural follow-up
chapters.description: Yacine follows up without repeating the wake phrase before deciding not to disturb Amit.
points: Mira considers bringing Amit into the meeting.
Yacine asks the current time in India.
They let Amit join on his own if he can.

chapters.title: Start a timer
chapters.description: A spoken clarification starts a visible ten-minute meeting timer.
points: Yacine asks for a timer.
Dial Bot asks how long.
The shared timer starts counting down.

chapters.title: See the shared slide
chapters.description: Mira shares the Friday slide and asks what its QA line says.
points: Mira shares the slide in Meetings.
Dial Bot reads the visible QA claim.
Mira flags the claim for verification.

chapters.title: Check the sources privately
chapters.description: Mira explicitly asks for source findings in her private chat.
points: Mira names the Jira issue and Glean decision log.
Dial Bot acknowledges the private handoff.
Mira summarizes the decision-relevant facts aloud.

chapters.title: Make the decision
chapters.description: The people decide Friday is a demo, then assign the revised deck and record the decision.
points: Yacine makes the Friday call.
Mira will check Amit's wording.
The Bot captures the action item and decision in this staged scene.

chapters.title: Recap the room
chapters.description: A short spoken recap prepares the team to bring Amit up to speed.
points: Mira asks for the clear version.
Yacine requests a room recap.
Dial Bot speaks only the shared decision and owners.

chapters.title: Catch Amit up
chapters.description: Amit joins from his standing invite and reads a private catch-up while the room keeps talking.
points: Amit joins voluntarily.
He opens Dial Bot's private message.
He reads the decision and open work in his own view.

chapters.title: Find the brief
chapters.description: Amit checks his current deck brief in a staged private connected-source answer.
points: Amit asks privately which brief is current.
The staged answer points to a fictional test record.
He confirms he will send the revised deck.

chapters.title: Share the meeting link
chapters.description: Mira asks for one copyable room link to send to Alex, the QA lead.
points: Mira explains why Alex needs to see the wording.
Dial Bot acknowledges the voice-to-chat request.
The test-room link appears in Everyone chat.

chapters.title: Plan the follow-up
chapters.description: A conceptual Calendar scene shows the checks and confirmation needed before booking.
points: Yacine asks privately who on the invite has not joined.
The Bot drafts a follow-up for his review.
The proposal is not booked; Calendar connection remains required.

chapters.title: Give the room back
chapters.description: Mira interrupts a proposed Bot answer to settle the next step herself.
points: Yacine asks what remains before Friday.
Dial Bot begins an answer.
Mira takes the floor and names the deck handoff.

chapters.title: Pause and resume
chapters.description: Yacine pauses Dial Bot while the people check the final wording, then resumes it.
points: Host Controls shows Pause Dial Bot.
Mira and Amit agree on the final headline.
Yacine resumes Dial Bot for the handoff.

chapters.title: Leave a clear handoff
chapters.description: The timer stops, Dial Bot leaves, and the room has the public decision and owners.
points: Yacine stops the timer before removal.
The staged room handoff omits private source details.
Amit and Mira continue with clear responsibilities.
